result:
Everything builds cleanly and renders correctly. Here's the summary of what was fixed and why, tied back to the GSC data:

**Fixed**
1. **`app/layout.tsx`** — metadata was stale from the old "InboxZap" brand while the page content was already "Lumina"; corrected the title/description/OG/Twitter tags to match, added `metadataBase`, and added `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD with `alternateName: "InboxZap"` so the ~14 monthly clicks still landing on "inboxzap" brand searches (pos. 4.1 in Queries.csv) resolve to the right entity instead of hitting a confusing mismatch.
2. **Blog** — was entirely `'use client'`, fetching a non-existent `/api/posts`, with no per-post route at all. Replaced with server-rendered `app/blog/page.tsx` and a new `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` using `generateStaticParams`/`generateMetadata`, each post statically built with real title/description/OG/`Article` JSON-LD and internal links. This directly targets the pattern in `gsc/Pages.csv`: posts 1–12 pull thousands of impressions each but ~0% CTR and position 42–58 — the signature of indexed-but-unrenderable/orphaned content.
3. **Content rewrite** — kept the same 12 slugs (preserving whatever indexing/impression equity they already have) but rewrote all of it from the old email-cleanup topics to genuinely useful, keyword-relevant posts about meetings/productivity, matching what Lumina actually sells.
4. **`app/sitemap.ts`** — had a literal `TODO` excluding all blog posts; now includes all 12 with `lastModified`.
5. **FAQ** — `/faq` 301-redirects to `/#faq`, but no `id="faq"` existed anywhere, so it redirected to nothing. Added a real FAQ section with `FAQPage` JSON-LD, including a direct "Is Lumina the same as InboxZap?" entry to capture residual branded search intent and reduce confusion/bounce.

Verified with a real `npm run build` + `npm run start`: clean build, all 12 posts statically generated, correct per-page metadata/JSON-LD rendering in the HTML, sitemap includes posts.

**Not fixed (flagging, didn't seem in scope to fabricate):**
- `/img/og-lumina.png` and `/img/og-inboxzap.png` are referenced but don't exist in `public/` — social preview images are broken. Needs a real asset from design, not something I should fake.
- `npm install` flagged `next@14.2.5` has a known high/critical security vulnerability (patch available) — worth a separate upgrade task, left untouched here since it's orthogonal to SEO and could have its own migration implications.
